title: Target anatomy
view: Front view of the skull, head at the top, the patient's right on the image left: the right orbit, both dental arches and the mandible to the chin.
teachingPoint: The mental foramen sits on the anterior mandible below the premolars, on the same vertical line as the pupil, the supraorbital notch and the infraorbital foramen; the needle aims down toward it from the fold and stops short.
claims: Front view, patient's right on the image left (house laterality).
Dashed red: the pupil line through the supraorbital notch, the infraorbital foramen and the mental foramen (record).
Mental foramen below the second premolar, midway between the alveolar crest and the lower border of the mandible (record: below the first or second premolar; height standard anatomy).
Needle from the mucobuccal fold below the premolars, directed inferiorly toward the foramen and stopping short of it (record).
Yellow: mental nerve branches to the lower lip and chin (standard anatomy).
Labels: Supraorbital notch, Infraorbital foramen, Mental foramen, Second premolar.
